text.guided: Look at the corners of the shape: the corner (1, 0) rides on î and the corner (0, 1) rides on ĵ. Find where those two corners sit in the target, and put the arrow tips there.
text.fast: Find where the corners (1, 0) and (0, 1) land, then place î and ĵ there.
